description: Defines the interface 'HandshakerDelegateInterface' for handling QUIC handshake events, including key management, transport parameters, and handshake completion notifications.

classes.name: HandshakerDelegateInterface
classes.description: Pure virtual class for handling QUIC handshake events and key management.

methods.name: OnNewDecryptionKeyAvailable
methods.description: Called when a new decryption key is available for a specific encryption level.

methods.name: OnNewEncryptionKeyAvailable
methods.description: Called when a new encryption key is available for a specific encryption level.

methods.name: SetDefaultEncryptionLevel
methods.description: Sets the default encryption level, used in QUIC crypto.

methods.name: OnTlsHandshakeComplete
methods.description: Notifies that the TLS handshake has completed with both 1-RTT read and write keys.

methods.name: DiscardOldDecryptionKey
methods.description: Discards old decryption keys for a specified encryption level.

methods.name: DiscardOldEncryptionKey
methods.description: Discards old encryption keys and neuters obsolete data for a specified level.

methods.name: NeuterUnencryptedData
methods.description: Neuters ENCRYPTION_INITIAL data without discarding initial keys.

methods.name: NeuterHandshakeData
methods.description: Neuters handshake data packet number space, called during key transitions.

methods.name: OnZeroRttRejected
methods.description: Called when 0-RTT data is rejected by the server.

methods.name: FillTransportParameters
methods.description: Fills transport parameters from the delegate's configuration.

methods.name: ProcessTransportParameters
methods.description: Processes received transport parameters and applies them.

methods.name: OnHandshakeCallbackDone
methods.description: Called at the end of a handshake operation.

methods.name: PacketFlusherAttached
methods.description: Checks if a packet flusher is attached.

methods.name: parsed_version
methods.description: Returns the current QUIC version in use.
